§ 00 · Source-level Observatory

agent-chief 注意力守门员

SmileLikeYe/agent-chief 把 agents、CI、RSS、heartbeats 等事件先送进本地判定漏斗，再决定中断、摘要、派发、记忆或丢弃。它值得拆的地方不是 UI，而是“便宜规则优先、LLM 最后兜底、所有判断可追踪”的源码组织。

§ 00 · OVERVIEW

它解决什么，凭什么值得拆

agent-chief 的核心不是再造一个聊天机器人，而是在 core/brain.py:115 到 core/brain.py:198 之间把事件标准化、场景识别、硬规则、相似度分类、LLM judge、持久化和异步执行串成一条可审计管线。这个设计让它像一个本地优先 chief of staff：先判断一件事是否值得打扰你，再决定丢弃、进入摘要、派给 agent 或升级为中断。

数据契约集中在 core/schema.py:19、core/schema.py:52 和 core/schema.py:68，分别定义 Event、Decision、Task。它没有把一切都塞进 prompt，而是让每一步产出结构化对象，再由 core/state.py:1 之后的状态层持久化，这就是它能 trace、eval、学习和回放的基础。

§ 01 · ARCHITECTURE

三段式判定，先便宜再聪明

第一道过滤器在 core/scorer.py:72，先用静态策略干掉 muted topic、dedup、zero-information 和 quiet-hours。尤其 core/scorer.py:61 到 core/scorer.py:69 用正则加 embedding 双条件识别“all clear”心跳，这比单纯关键词过滤稳，因为安全报告里提到 all clear 也不该被误杀。

▸Stage 1 硬规则

core/scorer.py · core/scorer.py:72-107Python
72def stage1(
73    event,
74    *,
75    now: datetime,
76    policy: Policy,
77    quiet_hours: str = "23:00-08:00",
78    night_whitelist: list[str] | None = None,
79    recent_dedup_keys: frozenset[str] | set[str] = frozenset(),
80    embedder: Embedder = DEFAULT_EMBEDDER,
81) -> RuleHit | None:
82    """Stage-1 hard rules (SPEC §4.4). Returns a forced route, or None to continue."""
83    night_whitelist = night_whitelist or []
84
85    # Drop rules run before the quiet-hours digest rule: noise must die even at
86    # night, or it would resurface in the morning digest (see §4.7 events 1/24).
87    if policy.is_muted(event.topic):
88        return RuleHit("drop", "muted_topic", f"topic {event.topic} muted in POLICY.md")
89
90    if event.dedup_key and event.dedup_key in recent_dedup_keys:
91        return RuleHit("drop", "dedup", "duplicate of an event seen in the last 24h")
92
93    if is_zero_information(event.summary, embedder):
94        return RuleHit("drop", "zero_information", "zero-information template (empty report)")
95
96    if in_quiet_hours(now, quiet_hours) and not _topic_in_whitelist(
97        event.topic, night_whitelist
98    ):
99        return RuleHit("digest", "quiet_hours", f"quiet hours {quiet_hours}, topic not whitelisted")
100
101    rule = policy.route_for(event.topic)
102    if rule:
103        return RuleHit(
104            rule.route, f"policy:{rule.pattern}", f"POLICY.md rule {rule.pattern} -> {rule.route}"
105        )
106
107    return None

在 core/scorer.py:87 到 core/scorer.py:99 里，muted、dedup、zero_information、quiet_hours 的顺序不是随意的：先把无信息噪声杀掉，避免它们进入 morning digest；再处理夜间白名单，保证生产事故或家庭类事件仍能穿透。

▸Stage 2 相似度分类

core/scorer.py · core/scorer.py:123-166Python
123class SimilarityClassifier:
124    """Compares an event against engaged/dismissed historical vectors (ms).
125
126    dismissed-sim > 0.88 with no engaged record → drop;
127    engaged-sim > 0.88 → skip judge, route by historical same-class mean;
128    otherwise → pass through to stage 3.
129    """
130
131    def __init__(self, embedder: Embedder = DEFAULT_EMBEDDER, threshold: float = STAGE2_THRESHOLD):
132        self.embedder = embedder
133        self.threshold = threshold
134        self._engaged: list[tuple[list[float], str]] = []  # (vector, route)
135        self._dismissed: list[list[float]] = []
136
137    def add_engaged(self, text: str, route: str) -> None:
138        self._engaged.append((self.embedder.embed(text), route))
139
140    def add_dismissed(self, text: str) -> None:
141        self._dismissed.append(self.embedder.embed(text))
142
143    def classify(self, text: str) -> Stage2Verdict:
144        vec = self.embedder.embed(text)
145        engaged_hits = [
146            (cosine(vec, evec), route)
147            for evec, route in self._engaged
148            if cosine(vec, evec) > self.threshold
149        ]
150        if engaged_hits:
151            # "route by historical same-class mean": majority route among the
152            # similar engaged records, nearest-first on ties.
153            engaged_hits.sort(reverse=True)
154            routes = [route for _, route in engaged_hits]
155            best = max(set(routes), key=lambda r: (routes.count(r), -routes.index(r)))
156            sim = engaged_hits[0][0]
157            return Stage2Verdict(
158                "route", best, sim, f"engaged-similar {sim:.2f}, historical route {best}"
159            )
160        dismissed_sim = max((cosine(vec, dvec) for dvec in self._dismissed), default=0.0)
161        if dismissed_sim > self.threshold:
162            return Stage2Verdict(
163                "drop", None, dismissed_sim,
164                f"dismissed-similar {dismissed_sim:.2f} with no engaged record",
165            )
166        return Stage2Verdict("pass", None, dismissed_sim, "unfamiliar; ask the judge")

Stage 2 的亮点在 core/scorer.py:145 到 core/scorer.py:166：engaged 相似就复用历史 route，dismissed 相似就 drop，否则才让 judge 介入。它把“我以前已经表达过态度”的事件从昂贵判断中拿出来。

§ 02 · BRAIN LOOP

Brain loop 如何把一次事件变成 Decision

相似度分类器从 core/scorer.py:123 开始保存 engaged 和 dismissed 向量，core/scorer.py:143 到 core/scorer.py:166 决定是直接 drop、复用历史 route，还是交给 judge。这个中间层减少了 LLM 调用次数，也把常见噪声压在毫秒级。

▸process 主流程

core/brain.py · core/brain.py:115-170Python
115    async def process(self, payload: dict | Event) -> Decision:
116        from ingest.normalize import normalize
117
118        now = self.now_fn()
119        clock = _StageClock()
120        if isinstance(payload, Event):
121            event = payload
122        else:
123            event = await normalize(payload, inferrer=self.inferrer, now=now)
124        clock.mark("normalize")
125
126        policy = load_policy(self.policy_path)
127        scene = self._scene(now)
128        recent_keys = await self.state.recent_dedup_keys(now - timedelta(hours=24))
129
130        # Triage merge (SPEC §4.2 step 1): a same-topic near-duplicate within
131        # 10 min folds into the earlier event; the earlier decision stands.
132        if self.embedder:
133            recent = await self.state.recent_events(now - timedelta(minutes=10))
134            prior = find_mergeable(event, [e for e in recent if e.id != event.id],
135                                   embedder=self.embedder)
136            clock.mark("triage_merge", note="merged into prior" if prior else "no near-duplicate")
137            if prior:
138                merged = merge_events(prior, event)
139                await self.state.save_event(merged)
140                existing = await self.state.load_decision(prior.id)
141                if existing:
142                    # the prior decision (and its trace) stands for the merged event
143                    return existing.model_copy(
144                        update={"reason": existing.reason + "; merged near-duplicate"}
145                    )
146
147        hit = stage1(
148            event,
149            now=now,
150            policy=policy,
151            quiet_hours=self.quiet_hours,
152            night_whitelist=self.night_whitelist,
153            recent_dedup_keys=recent_keys,
154        )
155        if hit:
156            clock.mark("stage1", note=f"rule {hit.rule} fired")
157            decision = Decision(
158                event_id=event.id,
159                route=hit.route,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
160                scene=scene.scene,
161                scene_confidence=scene.confidence,
162                cost=0.0,
163                matched_rules=[hit.rule],
164                reason=hit.reason,
165                stage=1,
166                trace=DecisionTrace(stages=clock.stages),
167            )
168        else:
169            clock.mark("stage1", note="no hard rule fired")
170            decision = await self._stage2_or_judge(event, scene, policy, now, clock)

从 core/brain.py:126 到 core/brain.py:154，Brain 先加载策略、场景和 24 小时 dedup key，然后再进入 stage1。注意 core/brain.py:130 到 core/brain.py:145 的 triage merge，它让 10 分钟内同主题近重复事件合并，避免同一个告警换个措辞就重复触发。

▸judge 降级策略

core/brain.py · core/brain.py:247-282Python
247        try:
248            result = await asyncio.wait_for(
249                self.judge.judge(event, context), self.judge_timeout
250            )
251        except Exception as exc:  # malformed output, timeout, backend down — never crash
252            logger.warning("judge %s unavailable (%s); degrading to rules-only", backend, exc)
253            last_error = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"[:200]
254            if self._degraded is not True or last_error != self._last_error:
255                # transition or changed failure mode: refresh the marker, but
256                # preserve `since` from any still-active record (incl. one
257                # written before a daemon restart mid-outage)
258                current = await load_degraded(self.state)
259                await self.state.set_meta(
260                    DEGRADED_KEY,
261                    {
262                        "active": True,
263                        "since": current["since"] if current else now.isoformat(),
264                        "last_error": last_error,
265                    },
266                )
267                self._degraded, self._last_error = True, last_error
268            clock.mark("judge", note=f"FAILED: {type(exc).__name__}")
269            # retries that failed were still paid for — bill them (JudgeError.usage)
270            usage = getattr(exc, "usage", None)
271            return Decision(
272                event_id=event.id,
273                route="digest",  # conservative: never interrupt, never drop, while blind
274                scene=scene.scene,
275                scene_confidence=scene.confidence,
276                cost=self._bill(backend, usage),
277                reason=f"judge unavailable ({type(exc).__name__}); "
278                "conservative rules-only routing to digest",
279                stage=3,
280                degraded=True,
281                trace=self._usage_trace(clock, backend, usage),
282            )

真正进入 judge 后，core/brain.py:247 到 core/brain.py:282 处理了超时、后端异常和降级：当 judge 不可用，它保守地送 digest，而不是盲目 interrupt 或 drop。这个失败策略很重要，因为注意力系统宁愿少叫你，也不能在 blind 状态下乱叫。

§ 03 · SCORING

score × scene 阈值，决定是否打扰

路由合成在 core/scorer.py:207 到 core/scorer.py:256：五个维度加权、场景阈值、全局学习调整、低置信场景降级，以及 dispatchable prep work。这个函数是 agent-chief 的决策阀门，读懂它就读懂了“为什么这个事件此刻该不该打扰你”。

▸score_and_route

core/scorer.py · core/scorer.py:207-256Python
207def score_and_route(
208    result,
209    scene: SceneState,
210    *,
211    topic_weights: dict[str, float] | None = None,
212    scene_cost: float = 0.0,
213    threshold_overrides: dict[str, float] | None = None,
214    threshold_adjust: float = 0.0,
215    memory_hit: bool = False,
216) -> tuple[str, float, dict[str, float], str]:
217    """Compose `score = Σ(w_topic[dim]·comp[dim]) − scene_cost` and route.
218
219    Returns (route, score, components-after-boost, reason).
220    """
221    from context.infer import downgrade_low_confidence, interrupt_threshold
222
223    weights = {**DEFAULT_WEIGHTS, **(topic_weights or {})}
224    comps = {dim: getattr(result, dim) for dim in DIMS}
225    if memory_hit:
226        comps["relevance"] = min(1.0, comps["relevance"] * 1.2)
227
228    score = sum(weights[dim] * comps[dim] for dim in DIMS) - scene_cost
229    threshold = interrupt_threshold(scene.scene, threshold_overrides)
230    if threshold_adjust:
231        # learned global adjustment, clamped (SPEC §4.6 bounds [0.35, 0.95])
232        threshold = min(0.95, max(0.35, threshold + threshold_adjust))
233
234    if score >= threshold:
235        route = "interrupt"
236        reason = f"score {score:.2f} ≥ {scene.scene} threshold {threshold:.2f}"
237    elif score >= DIGEST_FLOOR:
238        route = "digest"
239        reason = f"score {score:.2f} below {scene.scene} threshold {threshold:.2f}"
240    elif result.memorize:
241        route = "curate"
242        reason = f"score {score:.2f} low but worth remembering"
243    else:
244        route = "drop"
245        reason = f"score {score:.2f} with no lasting value"
246
247    route = downgrade_low_confidence(route, scene)
248    if route == "digest" and score >= threshold:
249        reason += f"; downgraded (scene confidence {scene.confidence:.2f} < 0.6)"
250
251    # SPEC §4.4: dispatchable prep work runs first, then delivery ("arrive with a plan")
252    if result.dispatchable and route in ("interrupt", "digest"):
253        route = "dispatch"
254        reason += "; dispatchable prep work available"
255
256    return route, score, comps, reason

值得注意的是 core/scorer.py:225 到 core/scorer.py:233：memory hit 会提升 relevance，学习到的 threshold_adjust 被夹在 0.35 到 0.95。也就是说，个性化会影响阈值，但不会把系统推到无限宽松或无限苛刻。

Decision 在 core/schema.py:52 到 core/schema.py:65 保存 route、score、components、scene、cost、matched_rules 和 trace。这个对象让 `chief trace` 能解释一次判断，而不是只留下一个不可追溯的自然语言结论。

§ 04 · MEMORY

记忆不是 RAG 巨塔，而是偏好证据

记忆层很薄但边界清楚：memory/store.py:20 负责 curate，memory/store.py:34 负责 top-k associate，memory/store.py:54 负责 TTL 过期归档。它没有做复杂 RAG，而是把偏好和历史事实作为 judge 上下文的补充证据。

▸MemoryStore

memory/store.py · memory/store.py:15-62Python
15class MemoryStore:
16    def __init__(self, state: State, embedder: Embedder = DEFAULT_EMBEDDER):
17        self.state = state
18        self.embedder = embedder
19
20    async def curate(
21        self, text: str, *, topic: str, origin_event_id: str | None, now: datetime
22    ) -> MemoryItem:
23        item = MemoryItem(
24            id=f"mem_{now:%Y%m%d}_{secrets.token_hex(3)}",
25            origin_event_id=origin_event_id,
26            text=text,
27            topic=topic,
28            embedding=self.embedder.embed(text),
29            created_at=now,
30        )
31        await self.state.save_memory(item)
32        return item
33
34    async def associate(self, text: str, *, now: datetime) -> list[MemoryItem]:
35        """Top-3 active memories with cosine > 0.78; updates hit stats (SPEC §4.2)."""
36        query = self.embedder.embed(text)
37        scored = [
38            (cosine(query, item.embedding), item)
39            for item in await self.state.list_memory()
40        ]
41        hits = sorted(
42            (pair for pair in scored if pair[0] > ASSOCIATION_THRESHOLD),
43            key=lambda pair: pair[0],
44            reverse=True,
45        )[:TOP_K]
46        results = []
47        for _sim, item in hits:
48            item.hit_count += 1
49            item.last_hit_at = now
50            await self.state.save_memory(item)
51            results.append(item)
52        return results
53
54    async def expire(self, *, now: datetime) -> int:
55        """Move items past their ttl_days into the archive table (SPEC §3)."""
56        moved = 0
57        for item in await self.state.list_memory():
58            if now - item.created_at > timedelta(days=item.ttl_days):
59                await self.state.save_memory(item, archive=True)
60                await self.state.delete_memory(item.id)
61                moved += 1
62        return moved

MemoryStore 的 associate 在 memory/store.py:34 到 memory/store.py:52 只取 cosine 大于 0.78 的 top 3，并更新 hit_count 与 last_hit_at。这个约束让记忆像判定证据，而不是把所有旧文本都塞进 prompt。

§ 05 · DISPATCH

“完成”必须被验证

派发层把“agent 做完了”当成一个需要证明的声明。dispatch/acceptance.py:30 到 dispatch/acceptance.py:54 先跑 acceptance_cmd，没有命令就用二次判定；dispatch/acceptance.py:57 到 dispatch/acceptance.py:88 明确最多重试一次，失败后找人接手。

▸acceptance verifier

dispatch/acceptance.py · dispatch/acceptance.py:30-88Python
30async def verify(
31    task: Task, *, ask: AskFn | None = None, exec_fn: Callable = _default_exec
32) -> VerifyResult:
33    """Check a completed task against its acceptance criteria."""
34    if task.acceptance_cmd:
35        argv = shlex.split(task.acceptance_cmd)
36        code, _out, err = await exec_fn(argv, None)
37        if code == 0:
38            return VerifyResult(True, "acceptance_cmd exit 0")
39        return VerifyResult(False, f"acceptance_cmd exit {code}: {err.strip()[:120]}")
40
41    if ask is None:
42        # No verifier available: never bless unverified work.
43        return VerifyResult(False, "no verifier configured; refusing to trust the claim")
44
45    prompt = verify_prompt(
46        acceptance=task.acceptance, result=task.result_summary or "(no result)"
47    )
48    raw = await ask(prompt)
49    try:
50        data = json.loads(extract_json(raw))
51        return VerifyResult(data.get("verdict") == "pass", data.get("reason", ""))
52    except Exception:
53        logger.warning("verifier returned garbage; treating as fail: %r", raw[:80])
54        return VerifyResult(False, "verifier output unparseable")
55
56
57async def dispatch_and_verify(
58    state: State,
59    task: Task,
60    executor: Executor,
61    *,
62    ask: AskFn | None = None,
63    exec_fn: Callable = _default_exec,
64) -> tuple[Task, str | None]:
65    """Run + verify with one retry (attempts max 2, SPEC §3); on final failure
66    mark the task rejected and return a message asking the human."""
67    last_reason = ""
68    while task.attempts < 2:
69        task = await run_task(state, task, executor)
70        if task.status == "done":
71            result = await verify(task, ask=ask, exec_fn=exec_fn)
72            if result.passed:
73                return task, None
74            last_reason = result.reason
75            task.status = "failed"
76            await state.save_task(task)
77        else:
78            last_reason = task.result_summary or "executor failed"
79
80    task.status = "rejected"
81    await state.save_task(task)
82    ask_human = (
83        f"I tried twice and couldn't finish this myself: {task.goal}\n"
84        f"Last attempt: {task.result_summary}\n"
85        f"Why it didn't pass: {last_reason}\n"
86        f"Can you take a look?"
87    )
88    return task, ask_human

派发失败路径在 dispatch/acceptance.py:68 到 dispatch/acceptance.py:88 很清楚：最多两次尝试，仍不通过就把 Task 标为 rejected，并生成一条请求人类介入的消息。这个设计避免 agent-chief 把未验证结果包装成成功。

§ 06 · RISKS

边界风险与可继续观察的点

▸风险 1：判定阈值的可迁移性

Stage 1 与 Stage 2 的参数在 core/scorer.py:31、core/scorer.py:112 和 core/scorer.py:171 固化得很清楚，但不同用户的噪声分布差异很大。仓库用 eval 证明默认值可用，生产接入时仍应先跑 shadow mode。

▸风险 2：派发执行器权限

当 route 变成 dispatch，core/brain.py:304 到 core/brain.py:314 会创建 Task。真正风险在 executor 能触碰什么系统，所以 acceptance_cmd、sandbox 和审计日志必须一起看。

▸风险 3：记忆污染
